attestations.text: LU Chien-tsêng 盧見曾 (T. 抱孫, H. 雅雨山人 and 澹園), 1690–1768, Nov. 7, scholar and official, was a native of Techow, Shantung. His father, Lu Tao-yüeh 盧道悅 (T. 喜臣), was a chin-shih of 1670. Lu Chien-tsêng himself became a licentiate at the age of fifteen sui, a chü-jên in 1711, and a chin-shih in 1721.
